title: Network and Capacity: *teljes mértékben*, *kiemelkedően*
grammar: Degree adverbs for how well a network works
goal: I can say how well a line or a network works with a degree adverb (*teljes mértékben*, *kiemelkedően*, *részben*, *alig*).
I can name the ideas of a transport network (*kapacitáskihasználtság*, *átbocsátóképesség*, *menetrendi szinkron*).
I can write one short sentence about how far a line is used.

sections.title: Unit 28: Railways, Transport and the Zone Tariff
body: This unit is about railways and transport: how well a network works, how modes of transport are linked, road against rail, why lines are modernized, and the zone tariff of 1889.
The unit ends with a text about the zone tariff that was introduced in 1889, under Baross Gábor.
